primary_title: Ghrelin is a ligand for the growth hormone secretagogue receptor
decision_basis: Mature acyl-ghrelin binds human GHSR1A and induces receptor-linked calcium and inositol-phosphate signaling in transfected cells
limitations_preserved: Promote mature acyl-ghrelin binding/activation of GHSR1A; preserve GHSR1A versus GHSR1B and heterologous GPCR-coupling context, without SCI inference.

primary_title: Molecular cloning and expression of a human pituitary receptor for vasoactive intestinal peptide
decision_basis: VIP binds the cloned human VPAC1 receptor and stimulates adenylate cyclase/cAMP signaling in receptor-expressing cells
limitations_preserved: Promote VIP binding/activation of VIPR1/VPAC1; preserve VIPR1 nomenclature, PACAP cross-reactivity and heterologous-cell context, without SCI inference.

primary_title: A human receptor for vasoactive intestinal peptide expressed in COS-7 cells
decision_basis: VIP binds cloned human VPAC2 with high affinity and stimulates cAMP in receptor-expressing cells
limitations_preserved: Promote VIP binding/activation of VIPR2/VPAC2; preserve VIP/PACAP ligand overlap and heterologous-cell coupling context, without SCI inference.

primary_title: Molecular cloning and expression of a complementary DNA encoding the PACAP receptor
decision_basis: PACAP binds cloned rat PAC1 and stimulates cAMP in transfected COS-7 cells, with ligand-form and receptor-isoform dependence
limitations_preserved: Promote PACAP-27/38 binding/activation of PAC1; preserve PAC1 isoform and PACAP molecular form, with VIP cross-reactivity and no SCI inference.

primary_title: Crystal structure of the PDZ1 domain of PDZK1 in complex with the C-terminal peptide of scavenger receptor class B type I
decision_basis: The SR-BI C-terminal VLQEAKL motif binds the first PDZ domain of PDZK1 in recombinant structural and biochemical assays
limitations_preserved: Promote direct SR-BI VLQEAKL/PDZK1-PDZ1 scaffold binding; preserve terminal-motif and adaptor-domain limits, without ligand-occupancy, kinase or SCI inference.

primary_title: The scavenger receptor stabilin-1 interacts with GGA adaptors and mediates intracellular sorting
decision_basis: Stabilin-1 cytoplasmic EDDADDD and DDSLL motifs associate with GGA adaptors and regulate intracellular sorting in receptor-tail pulldown and mutant-cell assays
limitations_preserved: Promote cooperative stabilin-1 tail/GGA sorting association; preserve EDDADDD plus DDSLL site-set and sorting rather than bulk-endocytosis semantics, without SCI inference.

primary_title: A novel cytoplasmic adaptor protein, autosomal recessive hypercholesterolemia protein, binds the cytoplasmic tail of megalin
decision_basis: The third megalin PsiXNPXY motif binds Dab2 PTB-domain activity in yeast-two-hybrid, in-vitro binding, tail-mutant and renal co-immunoprecipitation assays
limitations_preserved: Promote direct third-motif/LRP2-DAB2 endocytic sorting association; preserve motif numbering and renal proximal-tubule context, without kinase or SCI inference.

primary_title: A novel endocytic adaptor protein, ARH, binds the cytoplasmic tail of megalin
decision_basis: The first megalin FXNPXY motif binds ARH/LDLRAP1 and supports receptor recycling in motif-mapping, colocalization and endosomal itinerary assays
limitations_preserved: Promote direct first FXNPXY/ARH-LDLRAP1 sorting association; preserve distinct megalin motif usage from DAB2 and renal recycling context, without kinase or SCI inference.
